xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4438: Operator test-removal waiver has no writer since the Cut: pan verify waive-test-removal was deleted but the gate and docs still expect it

plan.title: Operator test-removal waiver has no writer since the Cut: pan verify waive-test-removal was deleted but the gate and docs still expect it
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The test-skip gate honors an operator waiver only when it covers the exact head under verification. Since the Cut (a1def1f8959) the only writer, `pan verify waive-test-removal`, is gone, and the reader looks in the workspace continue file, which is tracked on the feature branch: writing there dirties the tree (review request refuses it) and committing moves HEAD (the waiver pins the old sha). No waiver can be granted that the gate honors. PAN-4429 (PR #4431) is blocked on this.
narratives.Proposal: Store the waiver untracked at <workspace>/.overdeck/test-removal-waiver.json and read it only from there (delete the continue-file reader). One lib writer, grantTestSkipWaiver, pins the waiver to the live snapshotWorkspaceHeads anchor. Two operator-only doors call it: `pan review waive-test-removal <id> --reason` (refuses any agent identity via verdictCallerFromEnv) and `GET/POST /api/issues/:id/test-removal-waiver` (POST requires a trusted Origin and the head the operator saw; 409 if it moved), surfaced as a control in the dashboard Test/Lint verification panel when the test-skip gate failed. Operators then run `pan review request <id>` to re-verify with no commit. Docs describe the verb, control, store path, and the forgery limit.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Reviving the `pan verify` verb group
- Waiving an added .skip/.only/xit/xdescribe/xtest in any form
- Signing or tamper-proofing the waiver file
- Starting verification automatically on grant, or adding a new re-run button
- Supporting remote (Fly) workspaces
- Migrating or honoring continue-file D-test-removal-waived decisions
- Changing the whole-diff balance or the deleted-subject exemption
- Editing role prompts under roles/
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row

autoDecisions.summary: Store the waiver at <workspace>/.overdeck/test-removal-waiver.json, a sibling of .overdeck/verification/ rather than inside it.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator's comment asked for an untracked workspace verification artifact and gave the verification/ path as an example. Files in .overdeck/verification/ are parsed as run artifacts (verification-cycles.ts:88) and pruned after 30 days (verification-artifact.ts:139), which would misread or silently delete a waiver.

autoDecisions.summary: Delete the continue-file D-test-removal-waived reader instead of keeping it as a fallback.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue allows 'before (or instead of)'. No usable waiver can exist there (the deadlock), and keeping it leaves a tracked location agents can write.

autoDecisions.summary: Name the verb `pan review waive-test-removal <id> --reason` under the existing `pan review` group.
autoDecisions.rationale: `pan review` owns the review/verification loop (request, abort, restart); `pan verify` no longer exists and reviving a one-verb group adds surface.

autoDecisions.summary: CLI operator check uses verdictCallerFromEnv(), which refuses flywheel-* as well as pipeline agents.
autoDecisions.rationale: The deleted verb was operator-conversation-only (conv-*); verdictCallerFromEnv is the existing, ancestor-aware classifier for operator overrides.

autoDecisions.summary: Dashboard POST requires validateOrigin and the head the operator saw; a moved head returns 409.
autoDecisions.rationale: validateOrigin is the existing bar for dashboard mutations (lanes.ts); the expected-head check makes 'shows the head it pins to' a real guarantee.

autoDecisions.summary: Place the dashboard control in the Command Deck Test/Lint VerificationGatesPanel, under the failed test-skip gate output.
autoDecisions.rationale: That panel is the issue's verification view that already renders the test-skip gate's evidence.

autoDecisions.summary: Prove FR-9 with a real-git integration test and leave the live dashboard round trip to the test role.
autoDecisions.rationale: A temp-repo test exercises write-without-commit plus a green gate mechanically; the live `pan review request` path depends on dashboard state (approval, breaker) outside this issue.
